subject: Varsity Football Season Opener Against Belmont
overview: Student reporters from Mustang News Channel 15 provided highlights and interviews from the Medford High School varsity football season opener. Despite leading for portions of the game, Medford was defeated by Belmont with a final score of 31-28.

items.title: Game Introduction
items.summary: Reporters Lydia Ryan and Nick Kenniston opened the broadcast from the field at the varsity football season opener.

items.title: Pre-Game Interview
items.summary: Student Christian Gotti discussed key players to watch and the potential impact of recent injuries on the team's performance.

items.title: First Half Highlights
items.summary: The game coverage included Aaron Seeley scoring a touchdown on a kickoff return to start the contest for Medford.

items.title: Parent Perspectives
items.summary: A reporter interviewed Andre, the mother of a player, regarding her expectations for the game's outcome while Medford held a 14-9 lead.

items.title: Halftime Presentation
items.summary: Hallie Farrell and Lacey Ryan shared a football-themed joke and confirmed Medford's halftime lead.

items.title: Youth Attendance
items.summary: Middle school students Aidan and Dominic shared their excitement about attending their first high school football game.

items.title: Band Interview
items.summary: Student musicians Scott Andrew, Brandon Shaloney, and Paul D'Orio discussed the marching band's role in building crowd energy.

items.title: Final Score and Recap
items.summary: Belmont won the game 31-28, though reporters noted significant improvement in Medford's play compared to previous performances.
